body.name: \(\mathsf A\)
body.construction: Read only \(\mathfrak R\). Compute the outward rational upper radius \(B_\gamma^+\) and the fallback \(2B_\gamma^++(B_\gamma^+)^2/2\). Enumerate the \(K^J\) hard maximizing cells and run at most \(w_{\max}\) best-first subdivisions of \([0,1]\), \(\mathcal H\), \(\mathcal K_V\), and \([-B_\gamma^+,B_\gamma^+]^d\). All arithmetic, exponentials, logarithms, eigenvalue tests, evaluations of \(G\), and Gaussian probability integrations return outward intervals with rational witnesses. Emit the first refined \(q^+\) whose certificate verifies the target lower CDF; if no such certificate closes within the budget, emit the fallback certificate. The algorithm performs at most \(N_{\mathsf A}\) certified box operations and interval-oracle calls, each at precision at most \(m_{\mathsf A}\), and therefore halts on every valid effective input.
